capabilities: Synchronize vault flashcards to Anki in one direction
Define flashcards with standard Markdown including images, audio, LaTeX, and tables
Preserve existing Anki learning progress across syncs
Set deck names vault-wide or per file and tags per card or per file
Quickly link from an Anki card back to the source Obsidian note
disambiguation: One-way sync only: it pushes flashcards from notes to Anki and never imports Anki content back into the vault.
extras: Setup requires editing the AnkiConnect add-on config in Anki and restarting Anki; Anki must be running whenever the vault is scanned.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into Anki flashcards or keep them synchronized with an Anki collection.

relations.evidence: Plugin to sync flashcards in your Obsidian notes to Anki.

summary: Anki sync plugin that sends flashcards written in standard Markdown from your Obsidian notes to Anki, one direction only.
